lines.text: Do you know how a Venetian mask made everyone equal? For centuries, at Carnival, Venice let anyone hide who they were.
The classic mask, the bauta, covered the whole face. Its jutting chin changed your voice, and still let you eat and drink.
Add a black cloak and a three-cornered hat, and a servant and a noble looked exactly the same.
Behind the mask, rank didn't matter. People could talk, gamble, and trade, and nobody knew who was who.
Venice even passed laws limiting masks, when people abused the secret.
Orbi's Anonymous mode keeps the same spirit. No profile, no name, no GPS. Just a throwaway ID that's gone when you leave.
